Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game, [b]Curious Cases[/b]! 

[b]Curious Cases[/b] is a remaster of the [b]multiplayer escape-room[/b] formula, taking you on an adventure, playing as Detective Moore to solve the [b]Mystery[/b] of the missing scientist! Exciting new puzzles and interactions await!

If you have enjoyed The Experiment and have wanted more, you should give this a look! You can get it now for 20% OFF here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/[/url]

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: The Experiment begins!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890626/66a772c56146ce4b6a3a5ae85e77988bcfa1a61b.png[/img]

[h1]Hello and welcome to The Experiment!![/h1]

[b][u]The Experiment[/u][/b] is a multiplayer escape room puzzle game for virtual reality or desktop PC! You took part in an experiment that went out of control, you wake up in what looks like a doctor's office, but thankfully the doctor is missing. This is your chance to escape before they come back!

[i]Will you be fast enough?[/i]

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
